result.instructions: Tools for Nembol, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are not listed on Etsy yet?"; "Show the listings that failed to publish and why."; "Set the stock of SKU MUG-1 to 12 on every channel.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nembol data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nembol_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nembol_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nembol_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nembol_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nembol_get_store
tools.title: Get the store
tools.description: Return the store this API key belongs to: name, plan, base currency, mode (live or test) and the key's scopes. Good first call to check the connection. GET /store.

tools.name: nembol_list_channel_accounts
tools.title: List channel accounts
tools.description: List the connected sales channel accounts (Shopify, eBay, Etsy, Amazon, TikTok Shop and more). Take the channel_account_id from here; a store can have several accounts on one channel. GET /channel_accounts.

tools.name: nembol_list_products
tools.title: List and search products
tools.description: Search products by text, SKU, barcode, status, price or stock range, channel account, listing status or update time. All filters combine. Use updated_after for incremental sync. GET /products.

q.description: Text search over the product title and other text fields.

channel_account_id.description: Only products listed on this channel account.

updated_after.description: Only products updated after this time (ISO 8601).

cursor.description: Cursor from next_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: nembol_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Return one product with its variants, images, stock, prices and listing summary. GET /products/{id}.

product_id.description: The product id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

tools.name: nembol_list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: List listings (a product published on one channel account). Use status=error to find failing listings and error_contains to target one failure cause. GET /listings.

channel_account_id.description: Only listings on this channel account.

channel.description: Only listings on this channel, e.g. shopify or etsy.

error_contains.description: Only listings whose error contains this text.

updated_after.description: Only listings updated after this time (ISO 8601).

cursor.description: Cursor from next_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: nembol_get_listing
tools.title: Get a listing
tools.description: Return one listing: channel, status, URL on the channel, overrides, issues and the last operation id. GET /listings/{id}.

listing_id.description: The listing id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

tools.name: nembol_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders from all channels, newest first by the time they were placed. Each order carries its lines and fulfillment status. Needs the orders:read scope. GET /orders.

channel_account_id.description: Only orders from this channel account.

channel.description: Only orders from this channel, e.g. shopify.

created_after.description: Only orders placed after this time (ISO 8601).

updated_after.description: Only orders updated after this time (ISO 8601).

cursor.description: Cursor from next_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: nembol_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Return one order with its lines, totals, tracking and buyer data the key may read. GET /orders/{id}.

order_id.description: The order id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

tools.name: nembol_get_operation
tools.title: Get an operation
tools.description: Return a background operation (for example a stock update or a publish): status, one result per SKU and channel, and failures. GET /operations/{id}.

operation_id.description: The operation id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

tools.name: nembol_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the store's event log (orders, product and inventory changes, listing status, channel connections). Events are kept 30 days. Use it to catch up after downtime. GET /events.

account.description: Only events for this channel account id.

created_after.description: Only events created after this time (ISO 8601).

cursor.description: Cursor from next_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: nembol_list_actions
tools.title: List the action log
tools.description: List the changes made through the API and in the dashboard, with the before and after values. Kept 90 days. Use it to see what changed and to find an action id for an undo. GET /actions.

resource_id.description: Only actions on this resource id.

cursor.description: Cursor from next_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: nembol_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a product in the store. It stays a local draft and is not shown on any channel until nembol_publish_product_to_channel publishes it. POST /products.

description.description: Full description (may contain HTML as the channel accepts it).

sku.description: SKU. Must be unique in the store.

price.description: Price as a decimal string with 2 decimals, e.g. "19.90", in the store currency.

msrp.description: Price as a decimal string with 2 decimals, e.g. "19.90", in the store currency.

image_urls.description: Public http(s) image URLs (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, max 10 MB each). Nembol copies them.

tools.name: nembol_update_product
tools.title: Update a product
tools.description: Change a product's texts, brand, category, tags, identifiers or VAT rate. Changes reach every live channel listing that follows the product text. This tool does not change images. PATCH /products/{id}.

product_id.description: The product id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

expected_updated_at.description: Only update if the product still has this updated_at (ISO 8601); avoids overwriting a newer change.

tools.name: nembol_update_stock_and_prices
tools.title: Update stock and prices by SKU
tools.description: Set the stock quantity and/or the price for up to 100 SKUs in one call. The change is saved in Nembol at once and then sent to every channel the product is live on. Returns an operation to follow with nembol_get_operation. POST /inventory/batch.

price.description: Price as a decimal string with 2 decimals, e.g. "19.90", in the store currency.

annotations.title: Update stock and prices by SKU

tools.name: nembol_publish_product_to_channel
tools.title: Publish a product to a channel
tools.description: Create a listing: publish a product on one channel account. Publication is queued and runs in the background; follow it with nembol_get_listing or nembol_get_operation. Publishing the same product to the same account twice returns the existing listing. POST /listings.

product_id.description: The product id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

channel_account_id.description: The channel account id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

site.description: Channel site or marketplace code, if the channel has several.

category_id.description: Channel category id, when the channel needs one (see nembol_list_channel_accounts for the account).

annotations.title: Publish a product to a channel

tools.name: nembol_delist_listing
tools.title: Delist a listing
tools.description: Remove a listing from its channel. Irreversible: the channel creates a new listing if the product is published again, and reviews and watchers do not return. First call without confirmation_token: Nembol answers with a summary and a token. Show the summary to the user; only if they agree, call again with the same listing_id and the token. DELETE /listings/{id}.

listing_id.description: The listing id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

confirmation_token.description: Only after the user agreed to the summary of a confirmation_required answer: the token from that answer.

tools.name: nembol_mark_order_shipped
tools.title: Mark an order shipped
tools.description: Mark a channel order as shipped and/or attach tracking. Applies to the whole order. This is not undoable, and with tracking the source marketplace is notified (once per order) unless notify_channel is false. POST /orders/{id}/fulfillment.

order_id.description: The order id (prefixed, e.g. prod_..., acct_...).

mark_shipped.description: Set the order to shipped (default true).

notify_channel.description: Notify the marketplace of the tracking (default true).
